observed_mechanism: ChildLifecycleCandidate.current_state is a bare admitted enum string supplied by the caller.
The candidate carries no current-state evidence identity, digest, generation, reconciliation reference or producer binding that proves WAITING/RUNNING/TERMINAL for the exact child.
RESUME, REPLACE and NESTED_SPAWN decisions are gated directly on that unverified string after exact NativeChildRequest validation.

The test named terminal-child-never-resumes proves only that an explicitly supplied TERMINAL string is rejected for RESUME; it does not prove that an actually terminal child cannot be presented as WAITING and admitted as a RESUME candidate.
scope_conflict: The active claim correctly calls lifecycle state caller-supplied input, but also says the component enforces terminal-child non-resume. Without an exact state-evidence binding, that stronger invariant is not established for actual child lifecycle state; only caller-declared-state consistency is established.
counterhypothesis: WP604 may intentionally be only a declaration candidate and may never intend current_state to be authoritative. If so, the implementation can remain structurally similar, but acceptance language and field naming must stay explicitly caller-declared/untrusted and must not receive actual terminal-child state credit.
required_discriminator: Before WP604 acceptance, choose one explicit boundary: either narrow the claim to caller-declared lifecycle-state consistency, or bind current_state to exact prior lifecycle/reconcile/state evidence and revalidate that evidence at the consumer boundary.
If the narrow candidate-only option is retained, name/document current_state as caller-declared untrusted input and state that RESUME rejection applies only when the declared state is not WAITING.

If actual terminal-child non-resume is claimed, require an exact state evidence ref/id/digest/generation whose producer lineage binds to the same child/request identity before a RESUME candidate can be admitted.
Add a regression demonstrating that a terminal-state evidence object cannot be relabeled WAITING by caller input while preserving a positive RESUME candidate.
Do not infer child state, success, completion or world facts from this review or from the existing declaration-only candidate.
non_authority_statement: This review does not mutate the active WP604 implementation or claim, does not spawn/resume/replace a child, does not invoke a provider/model/tool, does not mutate UnifiedDB/DeliveryStore, and grants no runtime/VPS/physical-GRID10/GWT/J-Space/training/effect/completion/whole-system credit.
